candidate.blueprint_topic: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control
candidate.educational_objective: Apply CDC guidance on timing indicated perioperative antimicrobial prophylaxis to ensure effective tissue concentrations at the time of incision.

options.A: Time the antimicrobial so an effective bactericidal concentration is present in serum and tissues when the incision is made
options.B: Delay the first prophylactic dose until after the surgical incision is closed
options.C: Omit indicated antimicrobial prophylaxis if preoperative skin antisepsis is performed
options.D: Continue additional prophylactic doses after incision closure solely because a surgical drain remains in place

candidate.rationale: The CDC Guideline for the Prevention of Surgical Site Infection recommends administering antimicrobial prophylaxis only when indicated and timing it so a bactericidal concentration is established in serum and tissues when the incision is made. For clean and clean-contaminated procedures, additional prophylactic doses should not be given after incision closure solely because a drain is present.
candidate.source_claim_supported: When antimicrobial prophylaxis is indicated, it should be timed so bactericidal serum and tissue concentrations are present when the incision is made; routine additional prophylactic doses after incision closure are not recommended for clean and clean-contaminated procedures even with a drain.
candidate.source_document_title: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention Guideline for the Prevention of Surgical Site Infection, 2017
candidate.source_locator: Core recommendations: antimicrobial prophylaxis timing; prophylaxis after incision closure
candidate.source_organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
candidate.source_version_date: 2017 guideline; current CDC guideline page updated 2024-04-12
candidate.stem: A client is scheduled for a procedure for which perioperative antimicrobial prophylaxis is indicated. Which action is consistent with CDC surgical-site infection prevention guidance?
